_comment_key: A Public-access key is enough. Never paste a Limited/Full key into a tool you didn't write.
_comment_ffscouter: Optional. Your Torn key registered at ffscouter.com. Unlocks battle-stat estimates.
_comment_rate: Torn allows 100/min per USER across all your keys. 55 leaves headroom for playing.

me._comment: Used for the personal Fit score. Fill in or leave at 0 to disable.

discovery._comment_hof: Each page = 100 factions, fetched for 3 categories. 30 pages costs ~90 calls and finds most active factions.

id_sweep._comment_end: null auto-detects from the highest faction ID actually seen.
id_sweep._comment: Brute-force every faction ID. Thorough but slow: ~18 hours at 55/min.

enrich._comment_tiers: A faction is tiered by the last thing anyone in it did. Anything past dead_after_days is kept in the database but left out of the published rankings.
enrich._comment_stats: Only look up battle-stat estimates for the top N factions by respect. This is the slowest step; lower it to finish sooner.
